summary: Added the second-boundary receipt to the startup account: at MaxAppendEntries=1024, 131,072 committed entries (128 batches) returned in 45 ms while 131,073 entries (129 batches) did not return, so the same 128-batch capacity governs a replay with sixteen times the entry count. The limitation that no non-default boundary had been exercised is replaced by the two measured boundaries at 64 and 1024, with earlier cases unchanged.
